description: Export a curated GitHub source tree. Keep current core regression tests and exclude historical release-only tests, duplicate fixtures and maintenance-only tools. Local authoring tests are not deleted. Release notes and bilingual commit summaries belong beside ZIP/MSI, never in source exports.

important_coverage: installer launch, upgrade, folder picker and completion rendering
v1.1.0 scoped UI state, selected profile snapshots, solid menus and close progress
Login-only silent startup and cross-process shortcut activation
test_policy.review_rule: Add new tests only for active important behavior; remove superseded fixtures together with their runner scripts after dependency and regression verification.

release_changes.commit_title: Fix v1.1.3 UI interactions and login-only silent startup with existing-window activation
release_changes.commit_title_zh: 修复 v1.1.3 界面交互，并限定静默自启动及支持快捷方式唤起已有窗口

changes.change_zh: 将应用版本标识升级为 v1.1.3。

changes.change: Publish v1.1.3 while retaining upgrade and same-version reinstall behavior.
changes.change_zh: 发布 v1.1.3 安装程序，保留覆盖升级与同版本重新安装。

changes.change: Include active v1.1.3 behavioral regression tests and bilingual release summaries.
changes.change_zh: 纳入 v1.1.3 行为回归测试与中英双语发布摘要。

changes.change: Complete unlinked-profile localization, require explicit dropdown confirmation, unify solid dialog surfaces and proportions, show versioned update badges with a single About action, and remove misleading mouse-focus and dotted frames. Limit silent startup to enabled logon startup; manual launch shows the window and repeated shortcuts activate the existing instance before elevation.
changes.change_zh: 补全未关联配置的多语言显示，下拉框仅显式确认后应用，统一纯色弹窗底色和比例，更新角标显示版本且关于页仅保留一个更新操作按钮，修复鼠标焦点伪选中框及黑色虚线框。 静默启动仅作用于已启用的开机自启动；手动打开显示窗口，再次打开快捷方式在提权前唤起已有实例。

changes.change: Cover outside-dismiss cancellation, same-profile reapplication, localized sentinel labels, opaque dialog geometry, one-action update flows and keyboard/mouse focus visuals. Add a 16-case launch policy and real cross-process reactivation regression fixture.
changes.change_zh: 覆盖框外取消、同配置重复读取、多语言未关联项、纯色弹窗布局、单按钮更新流程及键鼠焦点显示。 新增 16 项启动策略及真实跨进程窗口唤起回归验证。
